title: Chapter 1862: The West (II)

Chapter 1862: The West (II)

A troubled look settled over Li Ximing’s face as he said, "There is another problem. Purple Mansion Realm cultivators are no minor figures. Even those without notable origins or formidable strength will have a friend or two, or ties to some power... We cannot simply act against them on a whim."

Li Zhouwei frowned as Li Ximing continued, "For example, there is a white elephant in the Southern Sea who cultivates Baleful Essence. Few pay him much attention, but his ancestors had ties to Buddhist cultivators. The Mahas of the Southern Sea all know him, and he has several friends of his own. If we traveled all that way to kill him without cause, we could offer no reasonable justification. Someone would certainly intervene, and our reputation might suffer badly. The same holds true in Poluoduo.

"In other words, these Purple Mansion Realm cultivators may lack powerful backing, but their connections and divine abilities are backing enough. They have their own divine abilities to rely upon and are far from ordinary. Even a Golden Core power would not kill them lightly without some conflict of interest.

"Besides, if the target escapes, or has relatives and friends... that will only bring further trouble."

His words set Li Zhouwei thinking. He asked, "What about Merciful Ones?"

Li Ximing nodded at once. "I had the same thought. Suitable Purple Mansion Realm targets are difficult to find, but Merciful Ones are easier. The one we know best is the [Great Boon Bronze-Color Temple]. We already have a feud with them, so killing a couple of peacocks over conflicting interests would be reasonable..."

But he gave a wry smile. "Yet something happened. The [Great Boon Bronze-Color Temple] lost two peacocks in recent years, both to violent deaths, and their investigations have uncovered nothing. It nearly left the temple's master all alone, much to the Great Desire Dao's displeasure. It would be very difficult to strike there now."

Li Ximing lowered his voice. "I asked Sima Yuanli. After much thought, he mentioned a temple of demonic creatures in the Western Sea that we could try. But that, too, comes with considerable complications... We would make enemies.

"I sounded them out. If we decide to go to the Western Sea, we can persuade Guo Nanwu by calling in a favor. But Sima Yuanli and the others are unwilling to join us. They have no quarrel with those powers, and will not make enemies of them merely because we wish to refine a spirit artifact... They may even consider us overeager and reckless. There was a hint of warning in their words."

Li Zhouwei was about to speak when Li Ximing continued, "There is another way: take advantage of the conflict between north and south. But few Buddhist cultivators have mounts and are willing to bring them south. I sent Guo Nanwu to Yinzhou and asked the Daoist Masters there to make inquiries. The Great Desire Dao has a newly advanced Maha called Bashan. His advancement also raised his mount to the rank of Merciful One. That mount could serve our purpose."

Li Zhouwei's eyes brightened. He silently weighed the gains and losses for a long time before saying, "Taking advantage of the war between north and south would certainly be the most convenient and justifiable approach. But we would have to wait quite some time, with no guarantee of capturing that Merciful One...

"Since Jiangqian and Quewan should emerge from seclusion around the same time, let us deal with that demonic creature in the Western Sea over the next few years and prepare one sacrifice first. When the north and south go to war, we can do our best to capture the mount as well. We will have a use for it eventually.

"If we arrange both matters properly, our family will have no further need for Purple Mansion Realm demonic creatures for a while. Only Jiangchun remains... His arts are difficult, and we have yet to secure his secret technique. His case can wait a little."

Their eyes met, and Li Ximing understood what Li Zhouwei meant.

Our family has talisman seeds to help dispel the Ignorance stage, sparing us those long years of waiting. That means the timing of the children's breakthroughs depends on their Dao conduct and the difficulty of their cultivation techniques. Quewan's technique is much harder, but with her Dao conduct, she should not take much longer... We do need to plan for them together...

He nodded, and Li Zhouwei said thoughtfully, "Handle this as tactfully as possible, without alerting the target. Since there is also the matter of [Wall-Sinking Water], I must trouble you to visit the Western Sea, granduncle. Deal with this and inquire into the local situation while you are there. We can accomplish two things in one journey!

"I recall that the [Supplementary Court Verdant Profound Cauldron] possesses [Renewal], which we have never found a use for. Mansion Water lies in the west, and Pit Water in the north. Granduncle, you can use condensing spirit water as your reason for going. You may earn some goodwill there as well... If it succeeds, that will be another welcome gain."

Having settled the arrangements, Li Zhouwei considered further. "As for Sima Yuanli... It does not matter whether he takes part himself, so long as he is willing to lend us that spirit treasure."

Li Ximing laughed. "He treasures it so much he does not even dare show it in front of me!"

Amusement warmed the King of Wei's golden eyes at the joke. "No matter. I will ask him myself."

————

The rain and snow had eased.

A lamp flickered within the cave dwelling. Documents of every size lay piled upon the stone platform and the floor. A youth in white stood among them, his brows tightly furrowed in thought.

Had I known... I could have memorized a few more arts...

Compared with his first life, Li Suining's second had been brief, and events had unfolded abruptly. He had never reached the point of wandering to the southern border as he had in his first life. Yet that did not mean all had been peaceful at Moongaze Lake.

Construction in the great void consumes immense wealth...

In his previous life, Li Zhouwei had entrusted him with the [Heavenly Directorate Sequence Arrangement Divine Scroll] and the method of construction in the great void. Li Suining had been astonished upon reading them, regarding them as priceless treasures that could help change their fortunes. Yet building a Profound Foundation in the great void had required a staggering quantity of spirit items.

This method of constructing a grotto heaven nearly exhausted the effort and resources of three generations. Between all the material combinations and wastage, even pouring in everything left from our gains at Changxiao Gate was far from enough... Moreover, Chengyun Gate had surrendered, so we could not plunder it.

His task now was to record every detail he remembered from his previous life's work on constructing the secret realm, ready for when they needed it!

The Profound Foundation's formation structure and spirit item proportions are extraordinarily complex, with thousands of combinations that must fit together. Fortunately, a Foundation Establishment Realm cultivator can recall them all, and I can work out the corresponding spirit items from their appearances. But that is secondary. There are also all those anchor points in the great void that Aunt Quewan spent two years calculating!

As he wrote in silence, a sound came from the cave dwelling's door.

Knock, knock...

Li Suining frowned and looked up, only to see a young man in an ink-black robe enter at an unhurried pace.

Startled, he hastily rose and bowed. "Greetings, your majesty!"

Seeing the King of Wei now filled Li Suining with sorrow, compounded by shame at having failed his trust. He squeezed his eyes shut, his voice catching slightly.

Li Zhouwei simply sat at a nearby desk and glanced at the documents piled everywhere. Without asking about them, he smiled and said, "You have been in seclusion quite some time. The old elder has asked after you several times."

Feeling guilty, Li Suining hastily bowed. "I lost track of time. Fortunately... I have gained a great deal!"

The King of Wei smiled without questioning him further. Standing in the cave dwelling with his hands behind his back, he said, "Daoist Master Zhaojing and I have a plan in the Western Sea... But concerns about an ambush have given us pause. I came specifically to consult you."
